headline: Exploring Newtown, Connecticut This Autumn
subhead: Scenic trails, historic Main Street, and convenient highway access in Northern Fairfield County.
caption: October brings vibrant fall color across Newtown, from the walking trails at Fairfield Hills to the scenic vistas at Holcombe Hill Preserve. Main Street is anchored by its historic architecture and iconic flagpole, offering local dining and cultural events at Edmond Town Hall. For outdoor recreation, Lake Zoar and Paugussett State Forest provide water access and wooded hiking paths, while area farm stands showcase the autumn harvest. Travel is convenient with direct access to Interstate 84 and Route 25 connecting across Fairfield County and beyond. If you are planning a move or exploring Newtown real estate, reach out today to get started.
